title: The Classic Plant-Based Starter Board
seo_title: Vegan Charcuterie Board for 6–8: Easy Starter Shopping List
description: An easy vegan charcuterie board for 6–8: cashew brie, hummus, almond ricotta, crisp vegetables, grapes, olives, nuts and fig jam. What to buy and a 25-minute plan.
hook: The plant-based board to make first: one creamy cashew cheese, two dips, crunchy vegetables and the same fruit, nuts and jam you'd put on any cheese board.
why: A good cheese board is about contrast, and none of that needs dairy. The cashew brie and almond ricotta bring the creamy, rich part; olives and crisp vegetables bring salt and crunch; grapes, apricots and fig jam bring the sweet.

Put the fig jam right beside the cashew brie and the walnuts next to both. Sweet, creamy and toasty in one bite is the same pairing people love with a dairy brie, and it's the easiest way to show a skeptical guest that plant cheese works.

timeline.what: Take the cashew brie and almond ricotta out of the fridge.
Slice the cucumber; rinse the tomatoes, snap peas and grapes.
Fill bowls with hummus, ricotta, olives and fig jam; place the cashew brie.
Fan the crackers and arrange the vegetables around the bowls.
Fill the gaps with nuts and apricots; serve.

faq.a: Yes, every item is plant-based. Check the labels on crackers, breads and store-bought dips, which sometimes contain butter, milk, honey or egg.

faq.q: Where do I find cashew brie?
faq.a: Most well-stocked grocery stores carry cultured cashew cheeses near the specialty cheese or in the vegan section. Any soft, spreadable nut cheese works in its place.

faq.q: How many people does it serve?
faq.a: 6 to 8 people as an appetizer, on a 14–16 inch board.
